### Buying a House in Carmel Valley: Common Questions

#### What is the median price of a single-family home in Carmel Valley?

$2,625,000, based on 212 single-family homes that closed in the last 12 months in ZIP 92130 (about $877 per square foot). Condos and townhomes are not included.

#### Can you still buy a house in Carmel Valley for under $2 million?

Yes, but there are few of them. 26 of 212 single-family sales in the last 12 months closed under $2M, mostly smaller or older homes and newer homes on compact lots. They tend to sell quickly, so set up alerts and be ready to act.

#### How fast do Carmel Valley houses sell?

The median single-family home sold in 10 days on market over the last 12 months. Well-priced homes in popular school areas often go under contract in the first week.

#### Which part of Carmel Valley has the most home sales?

South of Del Mar Heights Road had the most single-family sales in the last 12 months (48). Among areas with at least five sales, Del Mar Mesa had the highest median at $4,275,000.

#### Is this site for condos and townhomes too?

No. This site covers single-family homes only. For condos and townhomes, including HOA fees and Mello-Roos, see [Carmel Valley condos and townhomes](https://carmelvalleycondos.com). For every property type in one search, see [all Carmel Valley listings](https://carmelvalley.com).

### Carmel Valley Neighborhoods: Common Questions

#### How many single-family neighborhoods are in Carmel Valley?

This map shows 127 single-family neighborhoods in Carmel Valley (San Diego, 92130), with more than 11,300 homes between them. They are spread across 8 areas, and 36 of them are in Pacific Highlands Ranch.

#### Which Carmel Valley neighborhoods have the lowest and highest home prices?

Among neighborhoods with at least three house sales in the last 12 months, San Remo had the lowest median ($1.91M) and Rancho Pacifica the highest ($5.93M). Lot size, home age and school area explain most of the gap.

#### What are the largest single-family neighborhoods in Carmel Valley?

By number of homes, the largest are Heights (566 homes), Heights (566 homes), Palacio Del Mar (422 homes). Bigger neighborhoods have more sales each year, which makes prices easier to compare.

#### Where are the newest houses in Carmel Valley?

Pacific Highlands Ranch, east of the SR-56, was built out from the 2000s onward and still has some of the newest homes. Many of its neighborhoods pay Mello-Roos on top of property tax, so compare the full yearly cost.

#### How do I see what is for sale in a specific neighborhood?

Tap the neighborhood on the map or its card below. Where there is a guide, it shows live listings, recent sales and schools. For any other neighborhood, call or email Sez Sezer for current listings and recent sales.

### Not Sure Which Neighborhood Fits?

Tell me what matters to you (budget, school area, lot size, single-story, commute) and I’ll point you to the neighborhoods that fit, with current listings and recent sales for each.

### Pacific Highlands Ranch Homes: Common Questions

#### How much does a house in Pacific Highlands Ranch cost?

In the last 12 months, 58 single-family homes in Pacific Highlands Ranch sold at a median of $2,470,000 (about $877 per sq ft), below the Carmel Valley median of $2,625,000. Over the last 5 years, 278 sold for between $1,270,000 and $6,190,000.

#### Which neighborhoods are in Pacific Highlands Ranch?

Pacific Highlands Ranch has 36 single-family neighborhoods, including Sendero Collection, Portico, Arabella, Soleil at Bordeaux, Almeria, Elms. Among those with at least three sales in the last 12 months, Arabella had the lowest median ($1.95M) and Vista Del Mar the highest ($3.92M).

#### How old are the homes in Pacific Highlands Ranch?

Homes that sold in the last 5 years were built between 1996 and 2023, with a median year of 2016.

#### Do homes in Pacific Highlands Ranch pay Mello-Roos?

Many Pacific Highlands Ranch neighborhoods pay Mello-Roos (a special tax for local infrastructure) on top of regular property tax. The amount differs by neighborhood and year, so check the tax bill on every listing.

#### What schools serve Pacific Highlands Ranch?

Elementary school depends on the street: Pacific Sky Elementary (32% of recent sales), Sycamore Ridge Elementary (8% of recent sales), and Solana Beach School District schools for much of the rest. High school is Torrey Pines High, with Canyon Crest Academy and San Dieguito Academy by lottery. Confirm any address with the district.

#### How fast do homes sell in Pacific Highlands Ranch?

Over the last 12 months, the median home sold in 13 days on market.

### Del Mar Mesa Homes: Common Questions

#### How much does a house in Del Mar Mesa cost?

In the last 12 months, 10 single-family homes in Del Mar Mesa sold at a median of $4,387,500 (about $838 per sq ft), above the Carmel Valley median of $2,625,000. Over the last 5 years, 56 sold for between $2,800,000 and $10,895,000.

#### Which neighborhoods are in Del Mar Mesa?

Del Mar Mesa has 14 single-family neighborhoods, including Meadows Del Mar, Alta Del Mar, Bougainvillea, Whitehorse, Ridge, The Preserve. Among those with at least three sales in the last 12 months, Meadows Del Mar had the lowest median ($4.28M) and Alta Del Mar the highest ($4.5M).

#### How old are the homes in Del Mar Mesa?

Homes that sold in the last 5 years were built between 1978 and 2024, with a median year of 2004.

#### What schools serve Del Mar Mesa?

Elementary school depends on the street: Sage Canyon Elementary (75% of recent sales), Sycamore Ridge Elementary (25% of recent sales). High school is Torrey Pines High, with Canyon Crest Academy and San Dieguito Academy by lottery. Confirm any address with the district.

#### How fast do homes sell in Del Mar Mesa?

Over the last 12 months, the median home sold in 40 days on market.

### Two elementary school districts

Western and central Carmel Valley is in the Del Mar Union School District. Much of Pacific Highlands Ranch, Torrey Highlands and some neighborhoods north of Del Mar Heights Road are in Solana Beach School District: Solana Ranch, Solana Highlands, Solana Santa Fe, and Carmel Creek (K–3) with Solana Pacific for grades 4–6. Both send students on to San Dieguito Union High School District. Look up an exact address with [Del Mar Union School District](https://www.dmusd.org/Page/191) or the [Solana Beach SD school locator](https://www.schoolsitelocator.com/apps/solanabeach/).

### Carmel Valley Schools: Common Questions

#### Which elementary school serves my Carmel Valley address?

Most of western and central Carmel Valley is in the Del Mar Union School District: Sage Canyon, Pacific Sky, Ocean Air, Ashley Falls, Sycamore Ridge, Torrey Hills and Carmel Del Mar elementary schools. Much of Pacific Highlands Ranch and Torrey Highlands is in Solana Beach School District (Solana Ranch, Solana Highlands, Solana Santa Fe, and Carmel Creek with Solana Pacific). Boundaries can split a neighborhood, so check the exact address with the district locator.

#### What middle and high school do Carmel Valley homes go to?

Carmel Valley is in San Dieguito Union High School District. Middle school is Carmel Valley Middle or Pacific Trails Middle depending on the address. The assigned high school is Torrey Pines High, and Canyon Crest Academy and San Dieguito Academy are open by lottery.

#### Do homes cost more in some school areas?

Yes. Prices follow home size, age and lot as much as the school, but each school page shows the 12-month median and what houses inside that boundary sold for, so you can compare like for like.

#### How do I search for homes in one school area?

Tap the school on the map, then See homes. Each school page lists the neighborhoods inside the boundary and recent sales. Call or email Sez Sezer for listings inside a specific boundary, including homes not yet on the market.

*Schools*

### Assigned Schools

- Elementary — Sage Canyon Elementary — Del Mar Union School District
- Middle School — Confirm with the district — San Dieguito Union High School District
- High School — Torrey Pines High — San Dieguito Union High School District (Canyon Crest Academy and San Dieguito Academy by lottery)

School assignments can change. Verify current boundaries directly with [Del Mar Union SD](https://www.dmusd.org/Page/191) and [San Dieguito Union HSD](https://www.sduhsd.net/Our-District/About-Us-History/Boundaries-Map-/) before relying on them for a purchase decision.

### Life at Lexington

Lexington is a neighborhood of 265 homes built 1998–2003 in Carmel Country Highlands. Homes run 2,945–4,930 sq ft on lots around 8,448 sq ft, and about 5 sell each year.

#### Why buyers choose Lexington

- **Big floor plans.** The median home here has 4,537 sq ft, and 5-bedroom homes are the most common.
- **Bigger lots.** The median lot is about 8,448 sq ft, larger than the Carmel Valley median of 6,977.
- **School area.** Homes here are in the [Sage Canyon Elementary](https://carmelvalleyhomesforsale.com/sage-canyon-elementary-homes-for-sale/) attendance area.
- **Homes sell quickly.** Over the last 12 months the median home sold in 8 days, versus 10 across Carmel Valley.

*Find Your Fit*

### Is Lexington the Right Community for You?

Who it suits best, and the honest tradeoffs to weigh before you buy.

#### A great fit for

- **Buyers who want space** — 2,945–4,930 sq ft homes with 4, 5, 6 bedrooms.
- **School-focused families** — Sage Canyon Elementary for elementary, Torrey Pines High for high school.
- **Buyers who like predictable comps** — About 5 sales a year, so pricing is easy to check.

#### Tradeoffs to weigh

- **Prices above the Carmel Valley median** — Lexington's median over the last 12 months is $3.33M, versus $2.63M for all Carmel Valley houses.
- **Homes are 20+ years old** — Check roofs, windows and HVAC, and budget for updates in homes that haven't been remodeled.
- **Move fast** — In the last 12 months, half of all homes sold within 8 days. Get pre-approved before you start touring.

*Good to Know*

### Lexington Homes: Common Questions

#### How much do homes in Lexington cost?

Over the last 5 years, 26 single-family homes in Lexington sold between $2.6M and $3.88M. In the last 12 months, 10 sold at a median of $3.33M. See the price-by-bedroom cards and recent sales on this page for what each kind of home sold for.

#### How many homes are in Lexington?

Lexington has about 265 homes, built 1998 to 2003.

#### What school area is Lexington in?

Lexington is in the Sage Canyon Elementary attendance area (Del Mar Union School District). High school is Torrey Pines High (San Dieguito Union HSD), with Canyon Crest Academy and San Dieguito Academy available by lottery. School boundaries change, so confirm any address with the district before you buy.

#### How fast do homes sell in Lexington?

Over the last 12 months, the median Lexington home sold in 8 days on market. Well-priced homes often go under contract in the first week.

#### Where is Lexington in Carmel Valley?

Lexington is in Carmel Country Highlands, next to Steeplechase, Belmont, Breakers. See the map on this page for its boundary.
